summary.text: Gino Bulso is the Republican state representative for Tennessee House District 61, part of Williamson County, who took office in November 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Bulso earned a bachelor's degree in philosophy from Cornell College in 1983 and a law degree from Emory University in 1986.
Ballotpedia lists him as managing partner and attorney with Bulso PLC, and he chairs the Tennessee Supreme Court Advisory Committee on the Rules of Practice & Procedure.
Bulso has been a member of the House since the 113th General Assembly and chairs the Naming & Designating Committee.
The House website also lists him on the Calendar & Rules, Education and Judiciary committees.
Ballotpedia reports that he faces Democrat Becca Ripley in the general election.
